name: MotionSites Web Builder
cost: Free skill (MIT code). MotionSites Unlimited is a paid upgrade with more prompts and media
short: An AI skill that plans, builds, screenshots and fixes cinematic landing pages using MotionSites' prompts and media.
what: The skill gives the AI 40 example prompts from MotionSites, a shelf of 50+ hero videos, 30 3D cut-outs and 29 images, and 55+ technique recipes with code, such as video loops, liquid glass and Three.js models. It writes a build spec first, builds the page, then takes screenshots and fixes what it finds. It can also write a prompt for Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor and other builders instead of code.
who: Anyone who wants a landing page or portfolio homepage with motion and real media. If your site needs a plain, text-first layout, skip it.
needs: Claude.ai, Claude desktop or Claude Code
For Claude.ai and desktop: code execution turned on in Settings → Capabilities
Optional: Python and Playwright, so the skill can screenshot its own work

steps.title: Claude.ai or Claude desktop
steps.text: Download `motionsites-web-builder.zip` from the latest release. In Claude, open Customize → Skills → + → Create skill → Upload a skill, choose the zip and switch the skill on.

steps.title: Claude Code (plugin)
steps.text: If you have no GitHub SSH key, use `/plugin marketplace add https://github.com/Motionsites-AI/claude-skill.git` as the first line.

steps.title: Optional: let it see its work
steps.text: The look-and-fix loop works best with Playwright.
steps.code: pip install playwright && python -m playwright install chromium

try.label: From the README
try.where: Your AI chat or coding agent
try.text: Build a landing page hero for a luxury sleep-tracking ring.

watch: The example prompts and media are a free sample from MotionSites, and the README links to its paid Unlimited plan.
The skill's instructions and code are MIT. The example prompts and media stay © MotionSites, though you may use them in sites you build with the skill.
